import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        int t;
        while (b > 0) {
            t = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = t;
        }
        return a;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int y = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        int t1 = gcd(x, y);
        x /= t1;
        y /= t1;

        if (n >= y) {
            System.out.println(x + "/" + y);
        } else {
            double a = (double) x / y;
            double flag1 = a;
            int flag2 = 1;
            int[] ans = new int[n];
            double ans1, ans2, t, h;

            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                h = i * a;
                t = Math.floor(h);
                ans1 = Math.abs(t / i - a);
                ans2 = Math.abs((t + 1) / i - a);
                if (flag1 > ans1 || flag1 > ans2) {
                    if (ans1 > ans2) {
                        ans[i - 1] = (int) (t + 1);
                        flag2 = i;
                        flag1 = ans2;
                    } else {
                        ans[i - 1] = (int) t;
                        flag2 = i;
                        flag1 = ans1;
                    }
                }
            }
            System.out.println(ans[flag2 - 1] + "/" + flag2);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
